# Token Creators

## Token Launchpad

Creators can launch tokens with ease using the Basis proprietary smart contract framework, and apply varying degrees of stability (from more volatile Floor+ with a rising floor price and a configurable stability dial from 0%–100%, to only-up Stable+) based on the token use-case. Creators earn fees on token transaction volume — paid in USDC, not tokens.

### Creator Benefits

#### Multiple Revenue Streams

**DEX Fee Rewards:** Receive 20% of all trading fees generated by your branded token in perpetuity. For Stable+ tokens (0.5% fee), this means 0.1% per trade. For Floor+ tokens (1.5% fee), this means 0.3% per trade.

**Loan Fee Sharing:** Earn a share of loan fees when your token is used as collateral.

**Early Access Advantage:** Purchase tokens during the bonding phase (up to the configured bonding phase target) to earn perpetual USDC rewards.

**Ethical Cash-Out Options:** Take profits via 100% LTV loans against your tokens without selling them or negatively impacting the price chart.

#### Simple Token Creation

**Three-Step Process:**

**Step 1 — Metadata:** Token name, symbol, description, icon image (PNG/JPG/SVG, max 2MB), and optional social links (Telegram, X/Twitter, website).

**Step 2 — Tokenomics:** Starting liquidity ($100–$10,000), bonding phase USDC target ($100–$150,000), token type (Stable+ or Floor+). Floor+ shows a stability dial (0%–100%). Optional: Freeze token (whitelist-only trading initially), Auto-vesting (cliff or gradual, configurable period).

**Step 3 — Review & Launch:** Summary page → single contract call → ~$0.14 BNB gas cost.

{% hint style="info" %}
**All tokens start at $1.00** — there is no custom initial price. Starting liquidity controls the depth of the liquidity pool, which determines price impact per trade.
{% endhint %}

**Permissionless Access:** No approval needed - create tokens with any Web3 wallet

**Zero Creation Fees:** Pay only BNB gas fees (~$0.14)

**Fast Setup:** Launch your token in minutes with immediate liquidity

#### Web3 Brand Integration

**Crypto Community Exposure:** Introduce your brand to the growing Web3 ecosystem

**DeFi Participation:** Enter decentralized finance with minimal technical barriers

**ERC-20 Compatibility:** Work with standard Ethereum/BNB Chain infrastructure

**Token as Utility:** Enable Web3 transactions, governance, and loyalty programs

#### Fair, Transparent Launch

**Bonding Phase Mechanism:** Auto-generates initial liquidity up to the configured USDC target. Early buyers earn permanent Reward Shares (3.33% of all future trading fees for that token).

**Ethical Revenue Generation:** Earn through fees and loans without token dumps

**No Pre-Allocation:** Creators purchase tokens alongside the public - no insider advantage

**100% Elastic Supply:** Minted on buy, burned on sell. No fixed supply, no hidden minting functions.

#### Creator Controls (Dev Panel)

After launch, creators have access to:

* **Unfreeze:** Open public trading (one-way — cannot re-freeze)
* **Surge Tax:** Temporarily increase trading fees during hype cycles (7-day total quota)
* **Dev Tax Sharing:** Split your 20% creator fee across up to 10 wallets (1%–100% per wallet, displayed in basis points)
* **Whitelist Management:** Add wallet addresses with optional max buy limits during freeze phase
* **Token Info:** Name, symbol, type, supply, price, market cap, holders, frozen status
